description: Test suite for Telegram inline button helper functions using vitest. Contains tests for button construction, chat type resolution, and inline button derivation.

methods.name: buildTelegramExecApprovalButtons
methods.description: Constructs approval, allow-once, allow-always, and deny buttons with appropriate callback data.

methods.name: buildTelegramInteractiveButtons
methods.description: Builds Telegram inline buttons from shared button blocks and options.

methods.name: resolveTelegramTargetChatType
methods.description: Determines the chat type ('direct', 'group', or 'unknown') based on various Telegram chat identifiers.

methods.name: resolveTelegramInlineButtons
methods.description: Derives inline button configurations, preferring explicit buttons or deriving from interactive blocks.

ctags.name: explicit
ctags.pattern: /^    const explicit = [[{ text: "Keep", callback_data: "keep" }]] as const;$/
